text:
Maya: quick report from integrator call — they hit confusing envs again. Their ops engineer expected REDWOOD_API_KEY but our terraform examples used RW_TOKEN and the Dockerfile referenced RW_SERVICE_KEY.
Jon: argh. can you list the files?
Maya: infra/docker/Dockerfile -> RW_SERVICE_KEY, examples/node/quickstart.sh -> RW_TOKEN, docs/cli.md -> REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Priya: we should pick one canonical name and keep a short list of aliases. My vote: REDWOOD_API_KEY (primary), REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE (path to file), REDWOOD_CREDENTIALS_FILE (JSON envelope).
Jon: agree. Also recommend envs for scoping: REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT. Keep them short.
Maya: integrator asked about rotation: they want automatic refresh in long-running processes. Current node SDK tries once and then throws.
Priya: SDK plan: accept tokenProvider(fn) in all SDKs; if provided, call before 401 retries. Normalize auth failure to AuthError with {retryable:false}. Make refresh hooks opt-in in retries.
Jon: CLI change: `rw auth login --format=json` should output {"token":"...","expiry":"...","source":"cli"}. Also print a shell-safe snippet for bash/pwsh/fish. Warn explicitly: "Do not commit tokens" and include `REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE` example.
CLI-bot: note: existing `rw auth` currently prints plain export only. Issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/issues/88
Priya: implement an env-normalizer helper in each SDK: it reads canonical keys, maps legacy aliases, logs a single-line migration hint when legacy keys detected. Add opt-out with REDWOOD_SILENCE_ENV_WARN=true.
Maya: one small ask: when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE exist, prefer the file and log debug that file took precedence. CI mode (REDWOOD_CI=true) should error if both present.
Jon: security note: rotate by default for ephemeral CLI tokens (15m), advise service principals for CI. Add REDWOOD_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT for org-managed refresh flows.
security: heads-up: scheduled org rotation for "partner-sandbox" 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z; call us if you need exceptions.
Maya: action items: I'll grep repos and open PRs to standardize sample envs.
Jon: I'll file SDK parity issues for Go + Rust for tokenProvider and AuthError shape.
Priya: I'll draft the env-normalizer lib for node/python and a short migration doc with examples for shell variants (bash/pwsh/fish).
Maya: great. tagging @devex @sdk-maintainers. Will post PR links back here. :thumbsup:
